integrity: The quadratic identity is proved for all admissible infinite sequences; finite rational testing only corroborates it.
The unrestricted comparison is standard spectral theory and is not presented as novel.
scientific_limitations: Only nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences, common geometric input/output probability weights, output exponent 2 and input exponents at least 2.
This theorem does not classify arbitrary Hardy kernels or unrelated input/output weights.
Equivalent formulas in general historical cone Hardy theory cannot be fully ruled out without further original-source scrutiny.
title: Exact geometric Hardy inequality with a monotone-cone remainder
